sources.finding: An existing ERRORLEVEL environment entry supplies its own value instead of the dynamic error level.
/d disables AutoRun; /e:on enables extensions and /v:off disables delayed expansion. Command switches take precedence over registry defaults.
The documented set command requires extensions; /p reads a line from input.
